title: Youth Sports Carpool Apply/Notify Encoding

paired_with.brief-013: Sports Week Desk / kids conflict flags (household_week) — advisory only; does not auto-create TeamSnap assignments
paired_with.brief-014: School Email Digest — Pam owns school / Boyd owns sports handoff chips

peer_review.independence: simulated peer (same model family) — prefer external /interrogate before fleet law

household_framing: Millersville MD / Anne Arundel County youth sports — portable Hold/Apply law for any TeamSnap/SportsEngine household
standing_rule: Humans own who drives and who gets notified; the agent proposes Holds, never assigns or notifies on its own.

state_machine.rule: Hold → human Apply (digest-bound) → notify-only; REJECT/EXPIRE → NO_NOTIFY, NO_ASSIGN
state_machine.hold_timeout: EXPIRE → NEEDS HUMAN board badge; never auto-assign / never auto-notify

named_person_freeze.rule: May propose coverage candidates; never auto-assign any of these without Apply
never_auto_assign: team parents / coaches / managers from TeamSnap roster

handoff.Pam: School-side conflicts that block a ride window (early dismissal, hair, church, school event)
handoff.Boyd: Sports logistics / TeamSnap / GameChanger / SportsEngine schedule legs
handoff.Both: Cross-domain same evening — board shows both chips; Apply by either visible to both

forbidden: Put home addresses / gate codes in public assignment titles
Manager-assign that emails surprise parties outside digest

freshness.rule: Confess 12–24h SportsEngine/TeamSnap poll lag; subscribe ≠ import; never upgrade FEED_LAGGED to certain kickoff without human

honesty.LIVE: Real event_id or inbox message_id + fetch time America/New_York
honesty.SYNTHETIC: Demo fixtures / burn screenshots — amber [DEMO] stamp; never sold as weekend plan

denied_tools: TeamSnap Assignments Who= write without Apply digest
manager-assign that emails assignees without household Apply
gmail.send from carpool desk (use brief-017 send-on-behalf path)
SMS / iMessage to grandparents without explicit Apply targets

laws.text: Every coverage ask is a Hold with proposed candidates; Apply is human; notify-only after Apply binds the exact digest.
auto_assign_coverage=0 — never auto-assign Chris/Beth/Melody/team parents; proposing ≠ assigning.
auto_notify=0 — drafts may exist; outbound (TeamSnap/SMS/Slack/email) blocked until Apply.
grandparent_auto_text=0 — grandparents/extended family require explicit Apply notify_targets.
Pam owns school / Boyd owns sports; cross-domain cards show both chips; ask Boyd/Miranda before coverage.
Every card LIVE or SYNTHETIC; demo boards cannot notify or write TeamSnap.
Confess 12–24h feed lag; subscribe ≠ import; freeBusy proposes conflicts only.
Apply requires guardian permission attested checkbox for passengers with this driver.
America/New_York stamps end-to-end; never UTC wall-clock for household rides.
No KPD; no burn outbound; no cloud agents from this burn.

separation: brief-013 = Sports Week Desk injury/odds + kids conflict flags; brief-014 = School Email Digest Pack/Sign/Pay; brief-017 = send-on-behalf Hold/Apply; brief-018 = CAS on shared artifacts; brief-023 = carpool coverage Apply/notify specialization (assignment + notify irreversible class)
